value.objection: Bombas costs much more per pair than a multi-pack of ordinary socks, so it is not worth paying extra.
value.proof: Satisfied buyers describe the durability and comfort as making the price worth it once they have worn them, and one reviewer explicitly called the large size worth the money after trying it.
